title: Add custom-status CLI commands, filtering, and stats support
description: Implement the user-facing custom-state CLI on the catalog-aware provider. Add task create --status STATUS (default todo), task update/edit --status STATUS with atomic metadata changes, and task set-status <task-id> STATUS. Keep start, pause, and done as backward-compatible aliases through the same state-setting path. Parse configured statuses for task list --status, graph --status (plus all), and positional stats STATUS without hard-coded status lists. Make stats receive the active ordered catalog so statusCounts includes default and configured states in catalog order, including zero buckets; retain existing default JSON/text output byte-for-byte in unconfigured projects and existing focused-report shapes. Update CLI/provider test doubles and add thorough CLI/stats tests for custom create/update/set-status, alias compatibility, invalid names, reopen behavior, list/graph filters, all stats forms, filtered handoffs, and zero-count buckets. This task depends on catalog and provider work; do not defer test coverage.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Inspected the catalog-aware provider and identified the CLI/stats gaps: catalog-scoped parsing, status-bearing create/update inputs, set-status, and ordered catalog stats buckets. Implementing these paths with compatibility-preserving defaults.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Implemented catalog-scoped CLI status parsing, create/update status inputs, set-status, ordered stats buckets, and flat-file lifecycle handling for custom states. Added end-to-end custom create/update/reopen/list/graph/stats coverage plus updated test doubles and help/README contracts.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Final verification is green: go test -count=1 ./..., go vet ./..., and git diff --check. The implementation preserves default stats/report shapes and output while using the active catalog for custom status parsing and ordered zero-filled buckets.
